caption: I budgeted R2 500 for a service. The gearbox needed R7 800 and it needed it this month. Anyone else's month get hijacked like that?

slides.title: Bond
slides.body: Bought four years ago. The rate has moved twice and the repayment still surprises me each time.

slides.title: Car instalment
slides.body: Bought for the mine road, used mostly for school drop-off.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Family of three, one big shop and the mid-week top-ups
slides.body: The number that grows every year and never seems to shrink back.

slides.title: Car repair
slides.includes: Gearbox replacement, unplanned, paid in one instalment
slides.body: I budgeted R2 500 for a service. The gearbox had other plans and gave me no notice.

slides.title: Takeaways & stress spending
slides.includes: Two weeks of not cooking after the car news
slides.body: I don't usually spend like this. This was not a usual month.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Petrol & insurance, medical aid, electricity & rates, phone & fibre, funeral policy, school fees, stokvel
slides.body: R10 500 that runs every month regardless of what else goes wrong.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R45 500. On a normal month this is a comfortable number. This was not a normal month.

slides.title: I stopped assuming and started checking
slides.body:
I uploaded three months of statements to Beyond Horizon and it sorted every transaction for me.

Seeing the car repair against the actual budget was the first time I understood how far off the month really went.

No bank login needed.
